description_en: Initiates a VOD workflow for a video
description_zh: 对视频发起点播工作流处理
name: SubmitWorkflowJob

parameters.help_en: The workflow ID. Log on to the ApsaraVideo VOD console (https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose Configuration Management > Media Processing > Workflow to view the ID
parameters.help_zh: 工作流ID。可登录点播控制台 (https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择配置管理 > 媒体处理配置 > 工作流管理查看ID
parameters.name: workflow_id

parameters.help_en:
The media asset ID, which is the video ID. You can obtain the ID by using one of the following methods:
For videos uploaded through the console, log on to the ApsaraVideo VOD console (https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose Media Files > Audio/Video to view the video ID.
When you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55407.html operation to obtain the upload URL and credential, the video ID is the value of the VideoId parameter in the response.
After the video is uploaded, you can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86044.html operation to query the video ID, which is the value of the VideoId parameter in the response
parameters.help_zh:
媒资ID，即视频ID。可通过以下方式获取：
通过控制台上传的视频，可登录点播控制台 (https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择媒资库 > 音/视频查看视频ID。
通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55407.html接口获取上传地址和凭证时，视频ID为返回参数VideoId的值。
视频上传后，可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86044.html接口查询视频ID，为请求后返回参数VideoId的值
parameters.name: media_id
